description: This file contains platform-specific CPU feature detection code for the Abseil library, focusing on detecting AES support for cryptographic acceleration on various architectures (x86, PowerPC, ARM, AARCH64). It includes conditional compilation for different platforms and architectures, and defines functions to determine CPU capabilities related to AES instructions.

methods.name: CPUSupportsRandenHwAes
methods.description: Detects whether the CPU supports AES instructions or extensions necessary for hardware-accelerated cryptography, using platform-specific techniques.
